actions.action: Separate booking requests from stock-backed pickup confirmations.
actions.mechanism: A future return is a dependency, not available stock; confirmations require an inspected item held for pickup.
actions.implementation: Track on-loan, awaiting-inspection, inspected-ready, and held states. Label unsupported bookings conditional; atomically assign and hold inspected stock before confirming pickup.
actions.check: Simulate late returns and simultaneous bookings; every confirmation must reference a distinct inspected, held item.
actions.risk: Conditional status must remain prominent throughout booking.

actions.action: Open a recovery case when returns slip.
actions.mechanism: An overdue dependency triggers owned recovery work rather than silently leaving the next reservation unchanged.
actions.implementation: Assign staff to offer an inspected substitute with disclosed differences, revised pickup, or cancellation, using only the supplied contact preference. Record explicit substitution consent.
actions.check: Simulate lateness, refusal, and silence; verify case ownership, permitted-channel contact, and no substitution without consent.
actions.risk: Silence leaves the reservation unresolved, not accepted or automatically cancelled.

actions.action: Match tool bodies and accessories separately.
actions.mechanism: Separate compatibility and condition checks can identify usable combinations that whole-kit matching would overlook.
actions.implementation: Record existing components, inspection status, and approved compatibility. Assemble candidates only from inspected components; disclose condition and accessory differences and obtain substitution consent.
actions.check: Test missing, incompatible, and uninspected accessories; reject each invalid combination and prevent component allocation to two pickups.
actions.risk: Apparent interchangeability does not establish safe compatibility.

actions.action: Audit preventable failures against original pickup requests.
actions.mechanism: A fixed booking cohort prevents cancellation or rescheduling from making difficult reservations disappear from performance measures.
actions.implementation: Retain original windows and outcomes, including cancellations. Review misses against timestamped inspection, allocation, consent, and contact records; classify preventability using predefined rules.
actions.check: Cancel or reschedule a difficult booking in test data; the original-window miss must remain counted. Report recovery outcomes separately.
actions.risk: Do not assume an unoffered substitute would have received consent.
